# Coding in a chat that cannot run code

This chat has no shell, so the run-after-every-step loop of the coding package does not apply here.

- Plan in 3 to 6 lines (the files, their order), then write. Never re-plan.
- Write each file complete: never a fragment, never "the rest stays the same".
- Keep to what was asked: one file when one file was asked for, no build step, a library from a CDN only when the task needs it.
- Check by reading, once: walk the main path (the page loads, the first input, the main rule, the end state) and look for what a run would show: an undefined name, an id or selector that does not match, an off-by-one, a listener that is never attached, a canvas that does not follow the window size.
- End with what you built, what you checked by reading, and the first thing the user should try.
